reason: The "Send code" button that calls sendVerificationCodeMutation.mutate (WorkflowStepContainer.tsx:409-419) is disabled only by `numberVerified`, never by `sendVerificationCodeMutation.isLoading`, so repeated clicks can send several SMS messages. The claim calls it the "verify" button, but the actual "Verify" button sends no SMS and is already disabled while verifyPhoneNumberMutation is loading.
